usage.source_scope: Observed-versus-occluded stratification, informative-view selection, and depth-aware fusion concepts; generated hidden content is explicitly excluded.
usage.project_application: Use a read-only visible/occluded stratification to test whether SceneNN reference-plane errors concentrate in occluded pixels before considering any downstream geometry change.
usage.modifications: Do not generate labels, fill hidden door surfaces, or admit completed pixels into plane fitting, identity, scoring, or confirmation. Only measured visible pixels remain eligible evidence.
usage.expected_effect: Sharpen failure attribution and visibility gating. Stop immediately if an apparent gain depends on generated hidden appearance or geometry.

evaluation.setup: Mechanism reserve for occlusion-state attribution only.
evaluation.claim_boundary: Generated de-occlusion is a hypothesis and can never become geometric truth, exact-instance authority, visible-door evidence, arrival evidence, product benefit, or safety evidence.

evidence.summary: Primary paper link and author publication pages were reviewed for generative de-occlusion and depth-aware 3D integration; the BlindAssist use deliberately excludes generated truth.

history.change: Added as an occlusion-stratification reserve with a hard prohibition on treating generated hidden geometry as truth.
